entries.zh: 真正兄弟：同父母所生的亲兄弟（血亲兄弟）
entries.en: blood brothers; brothers of the same flesh, born of the same parents (hermanos carnales)

entries.zh: 小弟：弟弟、幼弟
entries.en: younger brother; little brother

entries.zh: 契弟：因受洗结契或结拜而称之弟（义弟）
entries.en: ritual younger brother — baptismal godbrother or sworn younger brother (义弟)

entries.zh: 继弟：继父带来的弟弟或过继之弟（暂依汉字栏定位，存疑）
entries.en: younger stepbrother; adopted younger brother (tentative)
entries.notes: 西语词头 espense padr~ 无法确解（padr~ 疑为 padrastro 继父），闽南音栏亦含残讹（'l ty'），暂依汉字栏'継弟'存疑定位；前页'繼兄'条同例。

entries.zh: 细姑（小姑）：夫之妹（小姑子）
entries.en: husband's younger sister (sister-in-law)
entries.notes: 西语栏作 hermano 而汉字栏细姑（姑＝女性）性别不合，疑西语栏笔误；前页'大姑'（hermano mayor del marido）条同例，依汉/闽两栏定为夫之幼妹。

entries.zh: 家兄：谦称自己的兄长
entries.en: my elder brother (humble form; manuscript note compares 'elder brother' / 令兄)
entries.notes: 官话栏旁注潦草（Lêng heng 疑为'令兄'，Bro mayor＝兄长），确证兄长义，细节未逐词解。

entries.zh: 父亲与母亲的兄弟（伯叔舅辈尊长）；汉字'尚父''尚母'确义待考
entries.en: brothers of one's father and of one's mother, i.e. uncles; Chinese compound 尚父尚母 (siâng-pē siâng-bú) not fully deciphered
entries.notes: '尚'字义四栏无从互证，仅依西语栏 her de padre y madre 与汉字父/母二字存疑定位。

entries.zh: 尊长称谓，汉字作'尚父各母'（确义待考）；西语词头无法确解
entries.en: reverential kinship compound (undeciphered; Spanish headword garbled)
entries.notes: 西语栏 verno padr~ y de mam~ 不可确解（verno 非标准西语词），'尚''各'待考，官话栏仅存 ma ty.，语义无从定夺。

entries.zh: 母系尊长称谓，汉字作'尚母各父'（确义待考）
entries.en: maternal-side kinship compound (undeciphered; headword reads 'brother of the mother and of an aunt')
entries.notes: '尚''各'待考，西语栏 dy ty~ 疑为 de tía 之残讹，官话栏空，仅存疑定位。

entries.zh: 相拚（相拼）：互相争斗、比拼；西语词头残缺且闽南音栏未能对合，原义存疑
entries.en: to fight or contend with each other (tentative; Spanish headword truncated and Hokkien column mismatched)
entries.notes: 西语词头 el mayor de [残] 截断不可复原；汉字相拼与闽南音栏 siò lâng 未能互证，义存疑。

entries.zh: 愚弟：谦称自己为'愚笨之弟'（书信或对话中的自谦语）
entries.en: 'foolish younger brother' — humble self-designation used out of modesty

entries.zh: 同胞兄弟：同父母所生的亲兄弟
entries.en: full brothers born of the same womb/parents; true brothers

entries.zh: 叔：丈夫的叔父（丈夫父亲的兄弟）；第二字形存疑（官/宮）
entries.en: husband's paternal uncle (brother of the husband's father)
entries.notes: 汉字栏第二字[疑:官/宮]，闽南音 cheg ua 与'官(koaⁿ)'音较合；官话栏空。

entries.zh: 昆仲：兄弟的书面合称（昆＝兄，仲＝弟）
entries.en: brothers (literary compound: elder brother 昆, second/younger 仲)

entries.zh: 二哥：排行第二的哥哥
entries.en: second elder brother (second-ranked elder brother)

entries.zh: 巖：山岩间的寺庵、隐修所
entries.en: hermitage; a temple or retreat built on a rocky crag (giâm)

entries.zh: 巖院：山岩间的寺院、隐修院
entries.en: hermitage temple (giâm-īⁿ); monastery compound on a cliff
entries.notes: 闽南音栏残损（u[残]ny bon[残]），汉西两栏对译明确，仍按残损例降为 low。

entries.zh: 桥亭：建于桥上的亭阁，常设神龛（hermita 之筑于桥上者）
entries.en: bridge pavilion; a shrine or hermitage built on a bridge

entries.zh: 佛骨：佛陀或圣僧的遗骨、舍利
entries.en: Buddha's bone(s), sacred relic (śarīra); note compares them to what the bonzes (Buddhist monks) guard
entries.notes: 西语词头 Hermitaño 与汉字佛骨义不直合，据官话旁注 como los bonbos y guardan（如僧人奉守）定为佛骨舍利义。

entries.zh: 食菜：吃素、素食（不食荤腥）
entries.en: to eat vegetables; to keep a vegetarian diet (eremitic abstinence)
entries.notes: 官话栏残字（de comir de ve[残]ras，可复原为 verduras），据四栏定为吃素义，仍按残损例降为 low。

entries.zh: 食草的人：吃素之人（'食草个(ê)人'，菜食修行者）
entries.en: vegetarian person — 'one who eats greens' (hermit-like vegetarian)
